label: prefix
defect: reeflog delivers events by seq and reorgs by reorg_id — two independent cursors. A retraction delivered BEFORE its event was answered "no such fill" and the mailbox receipt/cursor moved past the verdict forever; the later event delivery booked the fill OPEN, so the ledger permanently claims a reverted transaction is an open fill. Both transports reproduce it: retract-then-tail on one cursor pair, and a reorg POSTed before the event.

faces.detail: the retraction was delivered BEFORE the event (retract exit 0, cursor advanced), and the later tail booked the fill OPEN: open_fills=1, retractions=0 — the ledger claims a reverted transaction is open, forever; expected the crossed fill in retractions (got 0); the tail report does not name the refusal (retraction_first_ignored=undefined)
reorg-first ACKed 200, event ACKed 200 — fill OPEN: open=1 retractions=0 — the ACKed verdict was dropped by the receiver; the crossed fill did not land in retractions

the unknown-signature retraction left no consumable pending verdict (meta keys: retractions_seen, retractions_unknown) — the counter is a report nobody can act on, and the mailbox receipt says this verdict was delivered
